title: deserialize_header uses format\! for static error prefix
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs lines 172-175, the error message is constructed via format\!() which allocates a String. The error text 'header must have 1 or 2 elements (RFC 8621 §4.4.1), got {}' could be written without format\! using a string concat or by using serde::de::Error::invalid_length() which is the purpose-built method: serde::de::Error::invalid_length(h.len(), &"array of 1 or 2 strings"). Using invalid_length provides a structured, internationalization-friendly error that integrates better with serde's error reporting. The custom format string is functional but misses the semantic serde error type. Priority: minor style issue since tests verify the error text directly.
